ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
